feeds.title: MMB Magazine
feeds.description: MMB Magazine is supporting working mums. We have experts explaining everything from maternity leave, returning to work to parenting tips.

feeds.title: Family Friendly Working
feeds.description: A blog for working parents, parents who run businesses, & anyone looking for flexible work ideas. The blog is packed with news, tips, advice & experiences.

feeds.title: Boo Roo and Tigger Too
feeds.description: Boo Roo and Tigger Too highlights a journey through motherhood whilst juggling work, childcare, being a wife and having a life. It has evolved to showcase honest reviews, the days out they enjoy as a family along with a mis-match of everything else.

feeds.title: Honest Mum
feeds.description: Award-winning parenting and lifestyle blog. Empowering women to live their best lives, Honest Mum shares a frank and unique outlook on being a modern day mum. From the author of #Mumboss, you'll find everything from fashion advice to healthy recipes.

feeds.title: Jem blog
feeds.description: Web developer & work at home mama Jem's personal UK lifestyle blog on family, fitness & work. Free scripts, website resources & non geek stuff too.

feeds.title: Mum & Career Blog
feeds.description: Mum and Career offer tips, tools, links and guidance for professional working mums. We aim to inspire, inform and motivate you to create a lifestyle that works for you and your family.

feeds.title: Guilty Mother Blog | Kids and Home life
feeds.description: Guilty Mother is an honest and (sometimes funny) blog for mums who feel guilty about juggling work, kids and home-life.

feeds.title: Not Much Fun for a Working Mum
feeds.description: Get latest updated articles from Not Much Fun for a Working Mum blog authored by Sara Cottenden, a working mom.

feeds.title: Be a Freelance Blogger
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Sophie Lizard. I started freelance writing online in 2009 when I was broke, jobless, homeless and pregnant. In my blog You'll find out where the best jobs are hiding, how to negotiate with clients, how to set your rates, and what makes a successful freelance blogging career. I'll teach you everything I've learned in several years of freelance blogging, so you won't have to waste time making rookie mistakes or wondering how to get ahead.

feeds.title: WoMo - WoMo Network Blog for Working Mothers
feeds.description: We're talking about mothers who combine career and kids; juggling board books and board meetings, pampers and pitches. The WoMo network is on a mission: to support, empower and inspire more mothers to become WoMos. We're here to help you pursue your career and balance this with being an awesome mum.

feeds.title: Life/Redefined
feeds.description: WorkingMums.co.uk is a jobsite and community which connects mums with employers, and offers advice and support and business ideas to working parents. Follow this blog to get the latest news and views from Working Mums.

feeds.title: She's a Working Mum Blog
feeds.description: A Blog By Three Working Mums all heading back to work after maternity leave. Three different perspectives never usually the same.
